# ReVolta pull request

## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected ReVolta configuration.
For an upstream fix, include its source commit and any adaptations.
Link related issues and explain whether an existing pull request overlaps.
State any effect on the support scope in roadmap W10 and `.github/SUPPORT.md`.

## Validation

List exact commands and results. State hardware and configuration for runtime
checks, and identify unverified configurations.

## Attribution

Retain upstream authorship and license notices. Describe any AI assistance.
Confirm that the submitting human reviewed every changed line and can explain
the change. Sign off every commit under the Developer Certificate of Origin
with `git commit -s`.
